mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,name,phone_number AS phoneNumber,company_name AS companyName,owner_work_no AS owner,version FROM fcc_customer WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_work_no=#{owner} AND phone_number=#{phone} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,owner_work_no AS owner,job_type AS mode,status,max_attempts AS maxAttempts,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.number')) AS number,scheduled_at AS scheduledAt FROM fcc_dial_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_work_no=#{owner} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT owner_work_no FROM fcc_customer WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT owner_work_no FROM fcc_dial_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
